subject: Air freight to HKG via Munich
body:
Hello,

please quote 2 crates of sensors to Hong Kong (HKG), 480 kg, 1.6 cbm, ready 27.11.2026, with truck collection from our site in 65189 Wiesbaden.

Important: please route via Munich (MUC), not Frankfurt; our letter of credit names MUC as airport of departure. Cheapest option, all-in in EUR.

Best regards
Paul Schmitt
Export
Taunus Sensorik GmbH
